description: Source code for the TMP108 temperature sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including functions for reading/writing registers, configuring sensor attributes, fetching temperature data, and initializing the device.

methods.name: tmp108_reg_read
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit register from the TMP108 sensor via I2C.

methods.name: tmp108_reg_write
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to a register on the TMP108 sensor via I2C.

methods.name: tmp108_write_config
methods.description: Modifies the sensor's configuration register with a mask and new configuration bits.

methods.name: ti_tmp108_read_temp
methods.description: Reads the current temperature measurement from the sensor.
